list.question: Find the first observable desire, what makes it urgent and the choice that commits the protagonist. Try an earlier or later entry into the story. Trace a setup the ending will need.
Follow the chain of attempted solutions and consequences. Locate a reversal that changes available options, test its cost and show why the crisis forces a choice.
Test whether the climax follows from a choice the protagonist can actually make. Trace its setup and consequence. Protect the kind of closure the author wants, including uncertainty.

disclosure: Three AI dramaturgy roles offer editorial interpretations. The author decides which revisions to pursue.
title: Three acts: scene proposals
